name: Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's coding agent runtime; native Agent Skills consumer and one of the two v0.2 live trigger runtimes.

skillDiscovery.skillFormat: folder containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter plus a Markdown instruction body
skillDiscovery.notes: The personal install directory matches the Packsmith v0.1 target adapter (src/lib/targets.mjs: .claude/skills).

frontmatter.notes: Per the official frontmatter reference, name may be omitted (the directory name is used) and description is recommended, not required. The agent-skills specification's stricter MUST requirements are enforced separately as spec diagnostics (PS-SPEC-004/PS-SPEC-008) and must not be conflated with this runtime's tolerant loading behavior.
